description.value: Hibiki Ramen Yakitori Bar is a Japanese ramen and yakitori spot in Richmond's Oval Village area, operating primarily as a pickup counter via its Square online ordering system. The menu features a range of ramen bowls alongside karaage and grocery items. A cyclist swinging through the area can grab a hot bowl of ramen to go with a quick online order.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack at 12m; bollard at 28m; stands (4 spaces) at 43m; rack at 47m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 53m; stands (4 spaces) at 55m; stands (4 spaces) at 80m; stands at 100m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is an active Square ordering site confirming the business is open and operating for pickup at 4771 Mcclelland Road Unit 1460, matching the OSM address. The menu lists ramen and karaage dishes with pickup-only framing, confirming takeout as the primary service model; no information about bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other amenities is present on the site. No phone number appears in OSM tags or on the website.
concerns: No phone number available in OSM tags or on website.
Website is a minimal Square storefront with very limited business information beyond the menu and address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning online ordering site and confirmed address; useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal in Richmond.

Takeout.detail: Website ordering system is explicitly pickup-only: 'Pickup from 4771 Mcclelland Road Unit 1460'

wow_evidence: pickup counter via its Square online ordering system
